tradeDress.gate: Pre-release appearance review; revisit for EL506-382 before the final release. This is not legal advice.
findings: No Sharp logo, product wordmark, simulator bitmap, manual illustration, source screenshot or executable in the package.
Functional positions and legends are retained for instruction; case shape, colors, typography, button surfaces and all browser baseline images are independently authored.
No copied solar-panel ornament, proprietary decorative wordmarks, promotional product claims or false affiliation.
README states that this is an independent educational project with no Sharp affiliation or endorsement.
User-supplied src/OperationGuide_EL506TS.pdf remains untracked and is excluded from distributable package checks.

limitations: Later phases own numerical algorithms, power, full editing/history lifecycle, menu semantics, numerical formatting, and complete component generation.
Phase 2 multi-result tests inject already-computed coordinate, complex, equation, matrix and list page data; they do not claim those mode algorithms are implemented.
Fresh cursor fixture explicitly records remaining legacy decimal-point and retained-entry display differences.
Blinking is an intentional physical-manual exception to the simulator, disabled for reduced motion. Pixel baselines use stable reduced-motion frames.
Pixel regression baselines target Windows Chromium; Windows CI checks them, Linux CI retains structural and interaction assertions.
Screen/page geometry is original and responsive, rather than pixel duplication of the simulator artwork.
